protocol.comparison: Same rooted CNF parser, same common full lexical table including global refinement, fixed original frames and exact normalized rational probabilities. Global quotient competent, raw uses lexical memoization; no native EPIC mass comparison since it does not compute this law. Table/grammar/model startup recorded cold/prepared, shared forward and rational input conversion costs charged to each operation. No claim of full-generation timing from frozen inference. Position quotient refines only lexical-prefix reachable states at each physical slot; mandatory competent control. Count guards raised10x to avoid a capacity claim from a small chart budget; memory3GiB and whole-operation120s identical. Bidirectional controls use lexical forward/backward coaccessibility from ALL original choices and the actual fixed right suffix. Effects with unreachable next states become invalid in the per-position quotient. No grammar/gold/probability pruning; local and trimmed local are development candidates, choice fixed before independent capture. The independent predictive-stack control receives the same lexical trimming/local sums and primitive terminal coarsening, memoized deterministic grammar transitions, exact merging of arcs with equal target stacks, and safe necessary suffix terminal/closing-delimiter bounds. Its complete costs and original marginals are charged; no artificial depth ceiling. Predictive-stack suffix requirements are cached by residual stack per layer; caching and memory are charged. V5 development interrupted wholesale with all completed records preserved before independent captures. A23 also uses the same bidirectional lexical trimming and all original choices. Three new epsilon-compiler representations are variants of ONE candidate algorithm, not separately claimed inventions. ALL nine non-epsilon exact kernels, including both old local variants, are mandatory competent controls. Selection of epsilon representation happens solely on development strong-win count, tie selects eps_local then eps_position then eps_global, before any new independent model forward.

success.correctness: Mass and all original marginal numerator vectors EXACTLY agree among every conclusive exact method. Samples satisfy strict UTF8 JSON and fixed original IDs; independent law oracles before model.
success.utility: At least20% median prepared operation wall AND CPU against ALL nine non-epsilon exact controls, favorable sign every repetition, or localized additional operation capacity at identical budgets. Epsilon global/position/local are ablations of the same compiler; select one representation ONLY on development, tie eps_local then eps_position then eps_global. Do NOT claim a local-quotient advance if other epsilon variants share its benefit. All refusals/losses retained; zero strong wins rejects this compiler.
success.confirmation: After strengthened development gate, all18 reused refinement documents (including6 original fresh captures, now explicitly seen); ALL5 new JSONTestSuite documents with nine rotations. Selected candidate fixed before new forwards. No outcome selection.
success.claims: No new general epsilon-removal, semiring, sampling or differentiation principle, semantic accuracy, whole-generation speed, native EPIC superiority, training, human review or publication acceptance from frozen-step experiment.
